scientific_question: Is the rank-nine MPO's sparse-MoE c_proj deficit primarily a shared residual-direction gauge mismatch that one model-wide full-rank orthogonal transformation can remove?

theory_reconciliation.direction_evidence: Feature-to-write decoding failed, equal-budget Kronecker and MPO maps stopped near 0.33-0.36 recovery, and the functional spectrum requires a wide output frame. The model-wide rank-545 oracle nevertheless reached 0.9113 mean recovery with stable independent bases, showing that much of the missing information is a shared residual-output coordinate system.
theory_reconciliation.grouping_rejection: Three fixed depth groups at the identical state budget fell to 0.7087 mean recovery. Duplicating narrow output dictionaries is not the solution.
theory_reconciliation.single_discriminator: Compose every per-expert rank-nine MPO displacement with one shared R in O(768): Delta W_(l,e)=R M_(l,e). R changes full residual-output direction without imposing an ordinary low-rank write subspace or storing a private basis per matrix.
theory_reconciliation.matched_control: On entirely fresh token banks, refit an ungauged rank-nine MPO for exactly the same total number of Adam core steps. The only additional fitting operation in the treatment is a closed-form shared orthogonal Procrustes update.
theory_reconciliation.paper_scope: This is a diagnostic extension motivated by the Mapping-Network alignment principle and the measured residual gauge; it is not a technique reported by the original paper and is not yet a training result.
theory_reconciliation.no_sweep: The gauge sharing scope, MPO layout, outer rounds, optimizer, fresh seeds, thresholds, and state accounting are frozen. Failure closes this full-gauge upper bound; do not sweep rotations, ranks, radices, optimizers, or seeds.

source.target: With terminal same-run router and c_fc fixed, represent terminal c_proj minus exact reproducible step-zero c_proj in the routed terminal functional gauge.

mechanism.name: modelwide_full_orthogonal_residual_gauge_plus_rank9_interleaved_mpo
mechanism.equation: Delta W_(layer,expert) = R M_(layer,expert)(cores), with one R shared by all layers and experts.
mechanism.classification: A model-wide full-rank change of residual coordinates plus compact per-matrix hierarchical multilinear state; not LoRA and not an ordinary low-rank matrix family.
mechanism.budget_caveat: This diagnostic deliberately relaxes the c_proj-only 200x target. A pass authorizes a separate compression test for R; it does not make this full-gauge form an acceptable final parameterization.

functional_protocol.score: Exact routed residual-write recovery on untouched heldout tokens and heldout action agreement between independently fitted discovery banks.
functional_protocol.anti_leakage: All three token seeds are new after selecting this structure. Heldout tokens never update MPO cores, R, checkpoint choice, thresholds, or state accounting.

fit.initialization: Exact per-expert rank-nine TT-SVD of each terminal c_proj displacement and model-wide R=I. Endpoint access makes this an optimistic representability upper bound, not a causal training simulation.
fit.optimizer_state: Keep one Adam state per layer throughout all four treatment rounds. The matched ungauged control uses the same initialization, optimizer, and 512 consecutive steps.
fit.procrustes_update: For every layer, normalize current ungauged routed action P_l and target T_l by ||T_l||_F, concatenate tokens across layers, compute SVD(P^T T)=U S V^T, set Q=U V^T and R=Q^T. This exactly minimizes sum_l ||P_l R^T-T_l||_F^2/||T_l||_F^2 at fixed cores.
fit.best_pair_tracking: After each core update segment and exact Procrustes update, retain the treatment core/R pair with lowest total normalized discovery error. No heldout selection.

decision_rule.pass: Both independent gauge fits must pass every gate. A pass authorizes only a separately preregistered compression/parameterization oracle for the shared R, followed by exact-config MFU gating; it does not authorize language-model training.
decision_rule.fail: Reject shared residual gauge mismatch as a sufficient explanation for rank-nine MPO failure. Do not sweep gauge scope, rank, radix, optimizer, rounds, or seed; retain dense/full-state residual writes or relax the architecture objective.
decision_rule.scope: This is a zero-update representability upper bound on sampled layers 0/5/11. State compression is counted over all 12 layers and 8 experts.

execution.implementation_identity: The entrypoint hash and focused-test outcome must be sealed in the first implementation commit before any output path is created.
execution.policy: Run focused synthetic tests and an exact-shape no-scientific-value performance preflight. Foreground-poll only if estimated under five minutes; otherwise attach a persistent terminal/error watchdog with an event-specific @Codex callback.
